title: Long COVID and post-viral syndromes
bottleneck: Millions suffer persistent symptoms after SARS-CoV-2 infection, including fatigue, cognitive impairment, and dysautonomia, with no validated biomarker, no agreed case definition for trials, and mechanisms such as viral persistence, autoimmunity, and endothelial dysfunction still contested.
why_it_blocks: A mass-disabling condition with contested biology leaves patients without proven treatments and often without medical validation.
current_state: Large trials are testing antivirals, immunomodulators, and rehabilitation strategies. No therapy has yet shown consistent benefit for Long COVID. The lack of a biomarker means trials struggle to enroll homogeneous populations, and the contested mechanisms make target selection difficult. Patient-led research has pushed the field forward, but funding remains disproportionate to the burden. Until the biology is clarified, treatments will remain empirical and often disappointing.
